egress.terms: No traffic figure is given in the review; the limit named is 20 Mbps bandwidth.; ingress: udp

interface_detail: SSH key login out of the box on Ubuntu 24.04.
chaining: A throwaway WG endpoint for a week at a time, in Hong Kong.
binding_note: 20 Mbps sustained is about 6.5 TB per month, so the shaper does not block 1 TiB; what actually fails is the 7-day cycle, which is not a volume constraint.
reliability_note: NAT only, no dedicated public IPv4
confidence_note: One reviewer's post from 2026-10-06; no vendor page was read. The vendor's own page would raise the rung.

evidence.proved: USD 0.00, 7-day cycle, 20 Mbps, 50 GB disk, port mapping works, no dedicated IPv4

notes: A 7-day free window rather than a durable free tier. Useful as a test box, not as an ingress endpoint. The review is three weeks old at the time of writing.

extras.wg_detail: NAT VPS with port mapping; WireGuard runs on the box; whether a UDP port is among the mapped ports is not stated.
